text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto sent a message of congratulations on Wednesday to Bill Clinton on his re-election to the U.S. presidency, State Secretary Murdiono said.
"President Suharto has sent his congratulations to President Clinton," Murdiono told reporters following a cabinet meeting.

He said Suharto was also convinced that good relations between the two countries would strengthen the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum which is due to meet in the Philippines later this month.
Clinton and Suharto have met at two previous APEC summits and will meet again at the forthcoming summit at Subic Bay.
"Mr Suharto is convinced that good relations between Indonesia and the United States can strengthen APEC," Murdiono said.
He added that while there might be differences of opinion between the two countries, this was normal and could be settled as between friends.
